Name: ghcr.io/csi-foxbyte/regensburg_digitalerenergiezwilling_adminfrontend
Notes: Admin frontend image deployed by the addon; its verified, digest-bound SBOM is maintained as a modular child BOM.

Name: ghcr.io/csi-foxbyte/regensburg_digitalerenergiezwilling_backend
Notes: Backend image used for database migration and application runtime; its verified, digest-bound SBOM is maintained as a modular child BOM.

Name: ghcr.io/csi-foxbyte/regensburg_digitalerenergiezwilling_frontend
Notes: Public frontend image deployed by the addon; its verified, digest-bound SBOM is maintained as a modular child BOM.

Name: ansible-core
Notes: Executes the addon playbook; the version is supplied by the Civitas Core control environment.

Name: Apache APISIX
Relationship: required application gateway and policy integration
Notes: Routes frontend and backend traffic and enforces OIDC, role, CORS, rate-limit, and response-header policies; the version is supplied by Civitas Core.

Name: cert-manager
Notes: Issues certificates for the three annotated Gateways through the configured cluster issuer. Gateway API support must be enabled; the version is supplied by the platform.

Name: Civitas Core
Notes: The addon consumes Civitas Core inventory, shared access tasks, and platform services; the host version is selected by the deployment.

Name: jmespath
Notes: Required by the Ansible json_query filter used to select Keycloak clients; the version is supplied by the control environment.

Name: Keycloak
Relationship: required identity and access management integration
Notes: Provides the OIDC client, roles, client secret, discovery metadata, and token introspection used by the application; the version is supplied by Civitas Core.

Name: Kubernetes
Notes: Runs the Deployments, Services, Secrets, ConfigMaps, Gateways, and HTTPRoutes created by the addon; the cluster version is deployment-specific.

Name: kubernetes.core
Notes: Provides the k8s and k8s_info modules used throughout the addon; the version is supplied by the Civitas Core control environment.

Name: PostgreSQL
Notes: Stores backend application data in a database provisioned on central-db or another existing Zalando cluster, or in a separately managed existing database; the server version is deployment-specific.

Name: Traefik
Notes: Civitas Core uses Traefik as its reference Gateway API controller. The addon selects the platform controller via inv_k8s.gateway_class and routes its three hosts to the APISIX gateway service using Gateways and HTTPRoutes in the APISIX namespace; the controller version is supplied by the platform.

Name: Zalando Postgres Operator
Notes: Reconciles the acid.zalan.do/v1 postgresql resource used to provision the addon database on central-db or another existing Zalando cluster; not used in existing-database mode.
